generation_prompt: The robot grasps the white clock at the center of the table with its left hand and lifts it clear. It carries the clock into the wooden shelf's lower compartment, lowers it onto the slatted base, and opens its fingers to leave the clock lying inside. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: At frame 119, the clock lies inside the wooden shelf's lower compartment. The left fingers are open beside it and the right hand remains open over the table. The left hand has not fully withdrawn.

arm_hand_roles.left: Sole manipulating hand: reaches, grasps the clock case with thumb and opposing fingers, lifts and transports it, lowers it into the lower shelf compartment and opens to release.
arm_hand_roles.right: Open, largely stationary hand above the right side of the table; provides no support, grasp, transfer or stabilization.

uncertainties: The exact final contact points and clock face orientation are partially hidden by the open left hand and front shelf rail; the clock's location inside the lower compartment and the opened grasp are visible.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
